You will work closely with business leaders, executive stakeholders, engineers, and domain experts to understand how these organizations operate, identify high-value opportunities, and shape AI initiatives from discovery through execution. Headquarters: Remote 

Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.

Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.

We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. 

We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. 
We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer for Lithic’s Card Authorization team, which owns the real-time systems that make every card authorization decision correct, reliable, and fast. The team also owns related fraud tooling, including Lithic’s Rules Engine and 3D Secure integration. You’ll own high-impact projects end-to-end, solve distributed-systems problems at scale, and help build the tools customers use to control fraud and payment risk.

What you'll do:

• Write reliable, secure, scalable code for Lithic’s real-time authorization and fraud-prevention systems with minimal tech debt

• Build customer-facing features, such as rules improvements, velocity controls, 3DS flows, fraud tooling, and transaction monitoring. Own projects from planning to launch.

• Improve the reliability of systems in team’s scope and participate in the team on-call rotation

• Lead efforts to improve systems and processes within the team

What you'll bring:

• 4+ years building production backend systems. Full stack experience is a plus.

• Experience in or desire to learn Rust; ability to understand Lithic’s system written in other programming languages (Python, Java)

• Interest and experience in leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity

• Ability to navigate ambiguity, align diverse perspectives, and drive toward practical solutions

• Experience or interest in payments, fintech, fraud prevention.

• Comfort with designing systems from scratch and owning the product development process end-to-end

• Strong written communication skills and experience working in a remote, async-first team that’s spread across time zones

The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 to $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. 

This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

Headquarters: Portugal - Remote

Be Part of Building the Future

Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.  Learn more at www.dremio.com.
About the role

The Observability and Core Services team owns the platform foundation that Dremio is built on — and that every product team depends on to ship. As a core member, you'll design and deliver the critical building blocks: telemetry, messaging, KV store and persistence, application frameworks, caching, coordination, and events and audit services, along with Dremio's growing integration with the SAP platform. When these systems are rock-solid, the whole engineering org moves faster.

You'll work at the intersection of DevOps/SRE and application development — designing solutions that are highly scalable and genuinely easy to use — while collaborating with core product teams to ship safely and partnering with Field teams to support customers at enterprise scale.                                                                                        

This is also where Dremio's hardest distributed systems problems live. You'll tackle consistent persistence, distributed caching, networking, containerized services, private links, Terraform-driven infrastructure, and access control at scale. The scope is broad by design: we believe the best platform engineers are the ones who can hold the full picture and own problems end-to-end.                                                                                                         

You'll grow by taking on complex challenges, shipping high-quality systems at massive scale, and building the kind of foundational work that compounds across everything Dremio builds.              

What you'll be doing

• Build and own an observability platform that ingests customer telemetry — events, logs, and traces — using OpenTelemetry and industry best practices                                               

• Deliver dashboarding and visualization capabilities that give Support and Field teams real-time visibility into system health, emerging issues, and trends — and help customers stay resilient at scale     

• Design and implement a notification and alerting system driven by telemetry data and heuristics with AI agents and lakehouse intelligence                                                                                               

• Write infrastructure-as-code with Helm and Terraform to simplify deployment and operations within Dremio Software                                                                                  

• Build and maintain application frameworks that standardize development across teams — tackling cross-cutting challenges like dependency injection and role-based access control at scale           

• Partner with our SRE and DevOps teams to define best practices and deliver standardized solutions for common engineering workflows                                                                     

• Engage directly with the developer community to understand their pain points and turn those insights into platform improvements     

• Help define and deliver roadmap and integration milestones with SAP HANA/BDC platform to deliver a cohesive experience

What we're looking for

• Bachelor's, Master's, or higher in Computer Science or a related field                                                                                                                             

• 5+ years of software engineering experience                                                                                                                                                        

• 2+ years experience using Java

• 2+ years hands-on with infrastructure-as-code (Helm, Terraform, or equivalent)   

• Deep experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)                                                                                                                                   

• Hands-on with OpenTelemetry or comparable observability platforms                                                                                                                                  

• Experience with Kubernetes and Docker                                                                                                                                                              

• Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP)    

• Desire to learn new technologies and proven problem solver    

Bonus points if you have

• Experience building SaaS microservices and distributed systems                                                                                                                                     

• Hands-on with multi-threaded or asynchronous programming models                                                                                                                                    

• Proficient with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, RocksDB) or Redis                                                                                                                                        

• Background in CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, ArgoCD)          

• Other programming languages such as C++, Go, Python, Node.js, Rust, etc                                                                                                                                            

• Experience in query processing, distributed systems, concurrency control, data replication, or storage systems                                                                                     

• Java GC/heap tuning, Apache Arrow, SQL operators, or data-path optimization                                                                                                                        

What we value 

At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife.

Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor.

Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click here to review the privacy notice. 

Important Security Notice for Candidates

At Dremio, we uphold trust and transparency as paramount values in all our interactions with customers, partners, employees, and the general public. We have been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will be from an @dremio.com domain. Location: Fully Remote from India
Employment Type: Long-Term Contract
Shift: 2.00 PM – 11.00 PM IST
About Paralucent
Paralucent brings clarity to complex work, helping organisations move beyond complexity towards clarity through practical, thoughtful technology solutions.

Paralucent Core Values
We’re Driven to deliver real outcomes, and we Take Ownership from first question to final result. We’re Creative Problem Solvers who cut through complexity to bring clarity, and we’re Humbly Confident, with high standards, low ego and a commitment to continuous learning. Above all, we’re Customer Centric: we build with empathy, partner closely, and measure success by the impact we create for the people who rely on what we deliver.
Why This Role Matters
You will enable Agile delivery teams to work predictably, collaboratively and with a clear focus on value. As an experienced Scrum Master, you will facilitate Scrum ceremonies, remove delivery impediments and support continuous improvement in a SAFe environment. You will partner closely with Product Owners, Release Train Engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen team maturity, align delivery to programme objectives and help teams deliver meaningful outcomes.
Requirements
Key Responsibilities:

• Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews and retrospectives.

• Coach delivery teams on Scrum, Agile principles and SAFe practices to improve delivery predictability and team maturity.

• Support Programme Increment planning, including dependency management, risk identification and alignment to programme objectives.

• Partner with Product Owners to maintain healthy, prioritised product backlogs and clearly defined user stories.

• Identify, track and remove impediments affecting team performance or delivery timelines.

• Monitor and communicate delivery health, including sprint progress, velocity, capacity, risks, dependencies and delivery metrics.

• Drive continuous improvement through actionable retrospectives and measurable process enhancements.

• Strengthen collaboration across development, QA, product, architecture and business teams.

• Maintain Agile delivery artefacts in Azure DevOps, including boards, dashboards, reports and work item tracking.

Qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach or in a related Agile delivery role.

• Strong experience applying Scrum and Agile delivery practices within software or technology teams.

• Experience working in a SAFe environment, including Programme Increment planning and cross-team dependency management.

• Hands-on Azure DevOps experience, including backlog management, sprint boards, dashboards, queries, reporting and work item tracking.

• Demonstrated ability to facilitate meetings, resolve impediments and guide teams through change.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management and conflict resolution skills.

• Experience partnering with Product Owners and technical teams to improve backlog readiness and sprint execution.

Nice to Have

• Scrum Master certification, such as PSM, CSM or SAFe Scrum Master.

• SAFe certification, such as SAFe Agilist or SAFe Scrum Master.

• Experience supporting multiple Agile teams or Agile Release Trains.

• Familiarity with Agile metrics, including velocity, burndown or burnup, cycle time, lead time and predictability.

• Experience supporting enterprise software delivery, DevOps, cloud or digital transformation programmes.

If you want to do work you’re proud of, with people who own the outcome, this is your place.

aa165356e6f94eed.description: ### About the Role We are looking for a Core Machine Learning Engineer who can take machine learning solutions from prototype to production-grade, scalable systems. The ideal candidate combines strong fundamentals in machine learning, software engineering, distributed systems, and MLOps. You will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to productionize ML models, build reliable ML pipelines, optimize inference and training systems, and scale ML workloads to handle large volumes of real-world traffic and data. This role is best suited for an engineer who enjoys solving the difficult engineering problems that arise when moving ML from notebooks and experiments into high-performance, reliable production systems. You should care deeply about our Clients and strive to deliver value through applied science. You should work well in a fast-paced setting, using your skills to create effective solutions. With a combination of deep business know-how and hands-on skills, you will tackle complex challenges and drive continuous improvement. ### Key Responsibilities 1. Productionize ML Solutions * Take ML models and prototypes developed by data scientists/research teams and convert them into production-ready services. * Design robust model serving and inference architectures. * Build APIs and services around ML models for real-time and batch inference. * Develop reusable frameworks and components for deploying and operating ML models. * Establish standards for model versioning, deployment, rollback, monitoring, and lifecycle management. * Identify and eliminate gaps between experimental ML code and production requirements. 2. Build Scalable ML Systems * Design ML systems capable of handling high throughput, low latency, and large-scale workloads. * Scale model training and inference horizontally across multiple machines/instances. * Optimize CPU, GPU, memory, storage, and network utilization. * Design distributed processing pipelines for large datasets and ML workloads. * Develop asynchronous and batch-processing architectures where appropriate. * Handle bursty workloads and changing traffic patterns efficiently. 3. ML Infrastructure & MLOps * Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines covering: * Data ingestion * Data processing * Feature generation * Model training * Model validation * Model deployment * Model monitoring * Retraining * Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models and ML services. * Automate model deployment and infrastructure provisioning. * Establish reproducibility across training and production environments. * Implement model and data versioning. * Build monitoring for model performance, infrastructure health, latency, throughput, and data quality. 4. Model Serving & Inference Optimization * Optimize inference latency and resource consumption. * Evaluate and implement model serving technologies and frameworks. * Apply techniques such as: * Quantization * Pruning * Distillation * Batching * Caching * Parallel inference * Hardware acceleration * Optimize models for CPU/GPU/accelerator-based environments. * Design intelligent routing and fallback mechanisms for ML inference services. * Establish performance benchmarks and capacity requirements. 5. Machine Learning Engineering * Implement ML algorithms and production-grade ML pipelines when required. * Understand the underlying mathematical and statistical principles behind ML algorithms. * Work with supervised, unsupervised, and deep learning approaches as appropriate to the problem. * Evaluate model quality using appropriate offline and online metrics. * Investigate model degradation and production performance issues. * Develop mechanisms for continuous model improvement. 6. Data & Feature Engineering * Build reliable and scalable data pipelines supporting ML workloads. * Design feature engineering pipelines for both training and online inference. * Ensure training-serving consistency. * Handle large-scale structured and unstructured datasets. * Implement data validation and quality checks. * Design efficient feature storage and retrieval mechanisms. 7. Reliability & Production Engineering * Design ML systems with high availability, fault tolerance, and graceful degradation. * Implement observability across ML systems. * Troubleshoot production issues involving models, infrastructure, data, and services. * Establish SLAs/SLOs for ML services. * Build automated alerting and failure recovery mechanisms. * Participate in production incident response and root-cause analysis. 8. Collaboration & Technical Leadership * Work closely with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Data Engineers, DevOps/SRE, and Product teams. * Review ML architecture and production designs. * Establish engineering best practices for ML development. * Drive technical decisions around ML infrastructure, frameworks, and architecture. * Translate experimental ML solutions into maintainable engineering systems. ### BASIC QUALIFICATIONS - 3+ years of building models for business application experience - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field. - Strong professional experience in Machine Learning Engineering or a closely related field. - Strong proficiency in Python and experience writing production-quality software. - Strong understanding of machine learning fundamentals. - Strong software engineering fundamentals including: * Data structures and algorithms * Object-oriented design * Design patterns * Distributed systems * Concurrency/parallelism * API design * Testing - Hands-on experience deploying ML models into production. - Experience building scalable ML inference or training systems. - Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and containerized deployments. - Experience with Docker and Kubernetes or equivalent container orchestration technologies. - Experience with CI/CD and production deployment workflows. - Experience with databases, distributed storage, and caching systems. -
